name: Mek Gunz
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 55 pts for 1 model / 110 pts for 2 models / 165 pts for 3 models; 3rd+ unit 65 pts for 1 model / 120 pts for 2 models / 175 pts for 3 models.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1-3 Mek Gunz models. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Scavenged Shivs; 1 Smasha Gun.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: Any number of models can each have their Smasha Gun replaced with one of the following: ~ 1 Bubblechukka ~ 1 Kustom Mega-kannon ~ 1 Traktor Kannon Three or more choices for 'any number of models' is one picker per model.
